<function name="GetAdjacentCount" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the amount of <page>CNavArea</page>s that have a connection ( one and two way ) **from** this <page>CNavArea</page>.

See <page>CNavArea:GetAdjacentCountAtSide</page> for a function that only returns area count from one side/direction.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The amount of <page>CNavArea</page>s that have a connection ( one and two way ) **from** this <page>CNavArea</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
